name: spatial_nav_auto_scroll_container
description: SPATIAL NAVIGATION CONTAINMENT under `auto` (9a-i-b-i, css-nav-1): a scroll container (overflow: auto) is a spatial navigation container without any `spatial-navigation-contain` declaration. #f1 sits top-left INSIDE the box, #f2 bottom-right inside it (far, off to the side), and #out sits directly below the box, closer to #f1 and aligned with it. With containment, ArrowDown from #f1 must land on #f2 - the candidate inside the innermost container wins over the nearer one outside; without containment the aligned, nearer #out would win. The last ArrowDown from #f2 finds nothing inside and must escape outward to #out (the chain widens to the document). Tab focuses #f1 first (it is first in tab order).

css: #box { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 260px; height: 130px; overflow: auto; background: gainsboro; }
.item { position: absolute; width: 60px; height: 30px; background: silver; font-family: "Azul Mock Mono"; font-size: 20px; }
